_comment: Settings for the daily report. Edit values here; no code changes needed.
_prefilterTopN: Scan the full market with the cheap 24h endpoint, then deep-fetch 1m mark+last klines for the top N movers by daily range. Divergence only matters where price moved, so this catches the dangerous cases while staying fast. Set to 0 to deep-scan ALL symbols (slower, ~4-5 min).
_deepDivePages: Max number of full per-symbol 'story' pages in the PDF. The rest of the flagged symbols still appear in the summary tables.
_autoPublish: After each report run, rebuild the website's manifest.json and git-push reports/ so the GitHub Pages site (https://gorkemtikic.github.io/futures-daily-report) updates itself. Requires this folder to be a git repo with an 'origin' remote and a logged-in git/gh on this machine. Non-fatal: a push failure never breaks report generation. Set false to publish manually with 'node scripts/publish.mjs'.
_marketNews: New: adds a whole-market context page (real BTC/ETH/SOL data + a market chart) and an ATTRIBUTED news/social section explaining what moved the market. News is researched at generation time by the narrator (the 'cli' route runs a separate 'claude -p' with web search; 'api' uses the Anthropic web_search tool). It is written to reports/<date>/news.json, which you can also hand-edit or pre-fill — that file always wins. If no research is available (e.g. narrator='template' or offline), the section falls back to a truthful data-only summary and no headline is ever invented. Set false to skip news entirely (charts + macro data still render).
_narrator: Who writes the daily report prose/news/glossary (the new pipeline in pipeline/). 'auto' (recommended) = Anthropic API if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in .env (robust for the nightly job — no OAuth expiry), else headless Claude Code (claude -p) on your login, else a truthful data-only report. 'api' pins the API; 'cli' pins claude -p (free but its login token expires and must be refreshed with `claude`); 'template' skips AI entirely. With 'auto' + a key, the API is tried first and claude -p is the automatic fallback. A data figure is never invented — only prose/news come from the model.
_model: Model the 'cli'/'api' narrators use. Default Haiku keeps the no-key CLI route cheap (~$1/mo) because each daily 'claude -p' call reloads Claude Code's system prompt. Set to 'claude-opus-4-8' for richer prose (~$15/mo on the CLI route; much cheaper via a direct API key). Validated against /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/ before use.
_webTools: Whether the 'cli'/'api' synthesis may use WebSearch/WebFetch to verify and expand news. If a run's tool call fails to authenticate (some subscription tokens can't auth the tool path on large prompts), synthesis automatically retries WITHOUT web search — news then comes only from the collected RSS candidates (still real, never invented). Set false to skip web search entirely.
_maxTokens: Max output tokens for the synthesis and each translation. The full report (prose + up to ~12 news items + glossary + caveman) is large; too low a ceiling truncates the JSON and the run falls to data-only. Raise if you switch to a richer model.
_moversMinQuoteVolUSD: Liquidity floor (USD 24h quote volume) for a coin to be a headlined 'biggest mover'. Below this, coins are listed separately as 'newly listed / low-liquidity movers' so a 100%+ micro-cap swing isn't presented as the day's story.
_newsLookbackH: Hours before 00:00 UTC of the report day to still pull news candidates (for stories that broke late the previous evening). Items outside the report day are marked as context, not 'today'.
_wallClockMinutes: Overall soft budget for one run. When exceeded, remaining optional work (translations, publish) is skipped, the run is marked degraded, and it exits non-zero rather than being killed mid-write by the scheduler's hard limit.
_cliTimeoutMs: Per-call timeout for a 'claude -p' synthesis/translation. On timeout the whole process tree is killed.
_concurrency: How many Binance requests to run at once. 6 is safe under the IP weight limit.
